tagline: Document search for remote teammates — file contents ride along as resources.
requirements: Complete the Google Drive OAuth setup on the host first: create Desktop-app OAuth credentials with the drive.readonly scope, save them as gcp-oauth.keys.json in the working directory (or point GDRIVE_OAUTH_PATH at the file), and authenticate once so the token is stored (GDRIVE_CREDENTIALS_PATH controls where). This is the archived reference server.

tools.name: search
tools.note: Searches Drive and returns file names and MIME types. File contents are exposed as MCP resources on the same connection, so guests can read documents the OAuth account can access.

seo.description: Share Google Drive MCP search with MCPWire. Set up read-only OAuth credentials on the host, let teammates search shared documents over P2P, and keep the session read-only.
